ocr_mean_recognition_score_v1.source: PlateReader._parse; mean rec_scores, rounded to 4 decimals; split fusion keeps whole-crop score

private_rule_evidence_min_v1.source: route_plate; min(whole OCR score, reliable marker score), rounded to 4 decimals

plate_agent_joint_self_report_v1.source: AgentPrediction.confidence; one self-report copied to text and category, not independent marginals

vehicle_type_consensus_v1.source: aggregate_vehicle_type; winner mean detector score * (confidence share + observation share + winner margin)/3, rounded 4 decimals

vehicle_detector_latest_score_v1.source: ColourPipeline.process_frame; latest box.conf for the same latest normalized label

manufacturer_model_scores: No metric registered until a real capability and catalogue are reviewed; known results may have null scores.
